metadata.description: Environment name (also used as azd env name)
Compute region — Container Apps, Cosmos, Storage, VNet, App Insights.

AI region — Foundry AI Services (Voice Live, Agent Service, models) and Azure AI Search. Private endpoints for these still land in the compute VNet, so cross-region traffic stays on the Microsoft backbone.
Order Concierge project within the existing shared Foundry account.
Use independently hosted Order Concierge specialists after they have been deployed.
Opt in to reference-only adoption. No foundational resources, RBAC, models, app settings, or network configuration are reconciled.
Independent workspace placement. When omitted in reuse mode, use Apps, where the existing workspace now resides.
Deprecated optional compatibility label only. Never used to select or require an existing resource group.
Existing managed environment placement. Defaults to Apps for the replacement stack; set an explicit override for transitional deployments. Selection does not migrate app attachments.
Existing VNet placement. Defaults to Networking for the replacement stack; set an explicit override for transitional deployments.
Existing Cosmos private endpoint in Networking. Defaults to the approved replacement; set an explicit override for a transitional endpoint. Selection does not move its subnet.
Explicit greenfield-only opt-in for the retired ingestion worker. Content Understanding API capability does not require this workload.
Explicit domain activation. Existing retail behavior remains the greenfield default.
Operator-confirmed deployment readiness, never inferred from packaged files.
Explicit deployed insurance manager ID/version. Packaging does not populate or certify this value.
Opt in to the authenticated manual business APIs only after identity mappings are approved.
Preserved azd outputs for existing Foundry/runtime configuration. Required and validated only in reuse mode.
Principal ID of the user running azd up (granted data-plane RBAC on Foundry / Search / Cosmos for local dev).
Model deployment: planner
Model deployment: worker (fast + cheap for high-volume tool turns)
Model deployment: prompt agents. gpt-4o is required because Foundry prompt-agent function tools do not yet work on gpt-5.x.
Model deployment: embeddings for AI Search integrated vectorization.

Optional: extra Azure-direct model deployments for the "Model bake-off" tab. Each entry: { name, version, capacity, sku?, format? }. Includes first-party Microsoft models AND partner models from the Foundry Models catalog (Moonshot/Kimi, DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, etc.) — all served through this Foundry project with a single UAMI and OpenAI-compatible SDK. Default is empty because partner-model catalog availability varies per subscription + region. See docs/departments.md for the `azd env set BAKEOFFDEPLOYMENTS` override pattern. Bake-off with an empty array still works — it races the always-deployed planner + worker.
Enable the bounded Copilot SDK synthetic-demo harness. Existing workflows are unaffected when disabled.

defaultValue.description: RAG-only Foundry project for HR/IT internal Q&A. Owns the nw-hr Search index and the northwind-hr-assistant prompt agent.

Content Understanding project for warranty PDFs, damage photos, and intake forms. Owns the nw-claims Search index, the northwind-claim-intake CU analyzer, and the northwind-claims-triage prompt agent.
Voice Live front door project. Owns the nw-contact-center Search index, the northwind-intent-classifier prompt agent, and cross-project handoff to the Order Concierge orchestrator.

metadata.description: Additional Foundry projects — one per Northwind department beyond Order Concierge. Each project sits inside the same AI Services account so they share model deployments + UAMI, but each keeps its own agents, connections, evaluators, and Observability lens. To add or remove a department, edit this array and re-run `azd provision`.
Principal ID of the Azure AI Search service MI. Granted Storage Blob Data Reader so the search indexer can pull PDFs/markdown from the seed container.

Principal ID of the Azure AI Search service managed identity. Granted Cognitive Services User on this Foundry account so knowledge-base agentic retrieval can call the gpt-4o deployment for query planning and answer synthesis.

Optional extra Azure-direct model deployments to enable the "Model bake-off" tab. Only Microsoft first-party models on this Foundry account; no partner MaaS. Each item: { name, version, capacity, sku? }.
Additional Foundry projects to create alongside the Order Concierge project. Each item: { slug, projectName, displayName, description }.
